title: The function — the role of software in society
description: A conceptual essay examining software's broader societal impact through the lens of inputs, outputs, and the tools connecting them. Offers philosophical grounding for designers thinking beyond interface-level problems.

title: What Blade Runner got right about AI
description: A thoughtful analysis of how the Blade Runner films predicted the design challenges we face today with AI, exploring the practical realities of AI-assisted work beyond sci-fi fantasy. This essay connects film theory to contemporary UX problems, offering valuable perspective for designers building AI products.

title: When code is abundant
description: An essential strategic piece examining how AI commoditizes code production while revealing the real challenge: building trust, governance, and context around it. Critical reading for product leaders navigating enterprise AI adoption.

title: On teaching AI how you work
description: Explores the emerging paradigm of encoding personal workflows and judgement into AI systems, enabling one-command automation of complex multi-step processes. A glimpse into how AI agents will personalize themselves to individual work styles.

title: The AI Interface Museum
description: A visual archive documenting the evolution of human-AI interaction interfaces through history. Essential reference material for designers understanding the design patterns and lessons that shaped how we interact with intelligent systems.

title: Is Agentic
description: A practical tool that audits website readiness for AI agents and provides actionable recommendations for improvement. Timely for product teams preparing their interfaces for autonomous AI interaction patterns.

title: Tegaki
description: A creative tool that generates animated handwriting from any font, bridging humanized design with digital systems. Useful for designers looking to add personality and warmth to AI-generated or automated content.

title: Balsa UI
description: An open-code component system specifically designed for agent-native applications across Vue and React. Addresses the emerging need for UI frameworks built from the ground up for AI agent interaction rather than traditional human-centric interfaces.
